Note: If sufﬁcient scientiﬁc evidence is not available to calculate an estimated average requirement, a reference intake called an adequate intake is
used instead of a recommended dietary allowance. The AI is a value based on experimentally derived intake levels or approximations of observed
mean nutrient intakes by a group (or groups) of healthy people. The AI for children and adults is expected to meet or exceed the amount needed to
maintain a deﬁned nutritional state or criterion of adequacy in essentially all members of a speciﬁc healthy population.
